name: retrieval-benchmark-observation-materialization
scope: retrieval report to raw observation v3 materialization
requiredInternalChecks: one self-test raw observation v3 artifact
source report reference and SHA binding
materialization policy reference and SHA binding

requiredExecutionIdentity.commitSource: git rev-parse HEAD executed by the R0 executor
requiredExecutionIdentity.bindingRule: report execution.gitCommit and execution.runtime must be retained and match the frozen selection manifest

r0ExecutorInvariants: RJ_POSTGRES_CONNECTION is required and is never written to reports or diagnostics
catalog bytes and configuration bytes must match their supplied SHA-256 values before execution
configuration format is rjudi-retrieval-benchmark-config-v1 and limit is between 5 and 100
runtime retrieval implementation must identify as postgres-ts-rank-cd-v1 and match the configured implementation ID
executor resolves the exact git HEAD itself and records RuntimeInformation.FrameworkDescription
executor runs through PostgresLegalDocumentSearch and ILegalDocumentSearch; it does not accept a caller-supplied commit
R0 execution failure is distinct from quality measurements and materializes candidate_execution_failure
relevanceRule: exact DocumentId + ContentSha256 admitted evidence identity
decisionRules: expected answer prose is not a retrieval relevance input
cross-case hit is treatment execution failure
execution failure remains separate from quality measurements
duration is measured and is not a post-hoc acceptance threshold
Wave K self-test does not constitute EVAL-010 evidence or treatment selection
